## Outcome

Public commit activity was light. I used the midpoint to review the open branches and decide what I could realistically finish in the second half.

## What I Did

- Prioritized the text and facet branches that already had focused review feedback.
- Kept selector semantics and positive panel margins in the near-term review set.
- Revisited the long-running multiline-text branch and Toby Hocking’s collaborative `coord_equal` PR.
- Reserved time after those reviews for one small interactive-statistics experiment.

## Learnings

Several branches touched the same renderer boundaries, so finishing one could change another. That made the order of the work more important than the number of open PRs.

## Challenges / Notes

No major blocker appeared this week. The main constraint was choosing a smaller set of branches instead of treating every open PR as an equal priority.

## Next Week Targets

Add a browser-geometry test for multiline facet-strip overlap and fix the layout around the new lines.
